title: Wildly Wet Polish Herring Pasta
description: A savory Polish dish featuring a rich sauce and brine-wet herring, perfect for a satisfying dinner. This pescatarian-friendly recipe combines the flavors of the sea with traditional Polish ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
Drain the pasta and set it aside.
In a large skillet, heat some oil over medium heat and saute the onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the herring fillets to the skillet and cook for about 2 minutes on each side.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sour cream, chopped fresh dill, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the bowl and toss it with the sour cream sauce.
Add the cooked herring to the bowl and toss everything together.
Serve the Wildly Wet Polish Herring Pasta hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
